title.en: Unit 4 Notes — Estimate for Civil Engineering Works
title.gu: યુનિટ 4 Notes — Civil Engineering Works માટે Estimate

items.syllabus_item: 4.1 roads embankment canal earthwork mean sectional, mid sectional, prismoidal and trapezoidal methods

body.en:
First obtain chainages, longitudinal levels, cross-sections, formation/bed width, depths and side slopes, then determine separate cut and fill areas. For a level-ground trapezoidal section of bottom width b, depth d and equal side slopes m horizontal to 1 vertical, area is bd + md². On sloping ground, with different side slopes or irregular cross-sections, compute geometry from actual measured coordinates rather than using the symmetric formula.

Mean end area / trapezoidal: for distance L between sections, V = L(A₁ + A₂)/2. For many equally or unequally spaced sections, sum each interval using its own length; for equal spacing this becomes the familiar trapezoidal summation. Mid-sectional: V = LAm using the cross-section at the midpoint. Prismoidal: V = L(A₁ + 4Am + A₂)/6 when the mid-area is known and the prismoidal assumption is applicable. The actual midpoint area is required; it is not generally the average of endpoint areas. Mark separate cut/fill transition points; do not cancel one against the other without an explicit earthwork balance and shrinkage/swell assumptions.
body.gu:
પહેલાં chainages, longitudinal levels, cross-sections, formation/bed width, depths અને side slopes મેળવી cut તથા fill areas અલગ શોધો. સમતલ જમીન પર bottom width b, depth d અને બંને બાજુ m horizontal : 1 vertical slope હોય ત્યારે trapezoidal area = bd + md². ઢાળવાળી જમીન, જુદા side slopes અથવા irregular sections માટે symmetric સૂત્ર નહીં, actual measured coordinates થી geometry ગણો.

Mean end area / trapezoidal: બે sections વચ્ચે distance L માટે V = L(A₁ + A₂)/2. અનેક સમાન કે અસમાન intervals માં દરેકની પોતાની length થી volume ઉમેરી લો; સમાન spacing માં trapezoidal summation મળે છે. Mid-sectional: V = LAm જ્યાં Am midpoint પરનો area છે. Prismoidal: Mid-area જાણીતો હોય અને prismoidal assumption લાગુ હોય તો V = L(A₁ + 4Am + A₂)/6. વાસ્તવિક midpoint area જરૂરી છે; તે હંમેશાં endpoint areas ની average નથી. Cut/fill transition points અલગ દર્શાવો; સ્પષ્ટ earthwork balance અને shrinkage/swell assumptions વગર બંનેને એકબીજા સામે રદ ન કરો.

h.en: 4.2 Detailed estimate of a septic tank

body.en:
A septic tank is a watertight chamber in which sewage settles and undergoes anaerobic treatment; effluent needs an approved further disposal/treatment system. A typical arrangement has an inlet, one or more chambers or baffles, outlet, access covers and ventilation. Its construction and working must follow the relevant public-health design standard, site soil and groundwater conditions; this schematic is not a design or permission to discharge.

Take-off: derive excavation from external dimensions and required working space; separate PCC bedding, floor slab, side/end walls, partition, cover slab, reinforcement, formwork, internal plaster/waterproofing, pipework, manholes and disposal system. For masonry wall volume use external plan area minus internal clear plan area multiplied by height, adding partition separately only if not included; deduct openings and concrete members per applicable measurement rules. Calculate each item from drawing thickness and levels, then prepare the abstract. Never enter a septic tank without engineered confined-space controls, isolation, gas testing and trained rescue arrangements.
body.gu:
Septic tank એ watertight chamber છે જ્યાં sewage settle થાય છે અને anaerobic treatment થાય છે; effluent માટે મંજૂર આગળની disposal/treatment system જરૂરી છે. સામાન્ય વ્યવસ્થામાં inlet, એક કે વધુ chambers અથવા baffles, outlet, access covers અને ventilation હોય છે. Construction તથા working લાગુ public-health design standard, site soil અને groundwater conditions મુજબ હોવું જોઈએ; આ schematic design કે discharge ની મંજૂરી નથી.

Take-off: External dimensions અને જરૂરી working space પરથી excavation શોધો; PCC bedding, floor slab, side/end walls, partition, cover slab, reinforcement, formwork, internal plaster/waterproofing, pipework, manholes અને disposal system અલગ કરો. Masonry wall volume માટે external plan area માંથી internal clear area બાદ કરી height થી ગુણો; partition પહેલાં સામેલ ન હોય તો જ અલગ ઉમેરો. Opening અને concrete member ની deduction લાગુ rules મુજબ કરો. Drawing ની thickness અને levels થી દરેક item ગણી abstract બનાવો. Engineered confined-space controls, isolation, gas testing અને trained rescue વગર septic tank માં પ્રવેશ ન કરો.

h.en: 4.3 Detailed estimate of a community well

body.en:
A community well may include circular excavation, lining or steining, well curb, filter media or intake, bottom plugging where designed, platform, parapet, cover, lifting/pumping arrangement and drainage. Actual design depends on hydrogeology, depth, soil, water quality and local permissions; the illustration is not a structural design.

For circular work, distinguish the excavation diameter from internal water-space diameter and external lining diameter. Excavation volume uses the specified excavation dimensions; annular masonry or lining volume equals π/4 × (Douter² − Dinner²) × height. Add curb, concrete, reinforcement, shuttering and pump/platform as separate drawing items when not included in a rate. Work below water, dewatering, temporary support and disposal must be priced on the applicable specification; do not assume an unsupported excavation is safe.
body.gu:
Community well માં circular excavation, lining અથવા steining, well curb, filter media/intake, design મુજબ bottom plugging, platform, parapet, cover, lifting/pumping arrangement અને drainage હોઈ શકે છે. Actual design hydrogeology, depth, soil, water quality અને local permissions પર આધારિત છે; આ આકૃતિ structural design નથી.

Circular work માં excavation diameter, અંદરના water-space diameter અને lining ના external diameter અલગ રાખો. Excavation volume નિર્ધારિત excavation dimensions પરથી લો; annular masonry/lining volume = π/4 × (Douter² − Dinner²) × height. Curb, concrete, reinforcement, shuttering અને pump/platform rate માં સામેલ ન હોય તો drawing મુજબ અલગ ઉમેરો. પાણી નીચેનું કામ, dewatering, temporary support અને disposal લાગુ specification મુજબ price કરો; unsupported excavation સલામત છે એમ ન માનો.

h.gu: 4.4 Spreadsheet અને estimating software ની પ્રક્રિયા

items.syllabus_item: 4.3 computer software programs for detailed estimate

body.en:
A spreadsheet can store item code, description, number, length, breadth, depth, quantity, unit, rate and amount. For a simple volume line use quantity = number × length × breadth × depth; use separate area, length and number formulas where appropriate. Group by item, link rates to a dated SOR table, calculate totals and show tax/charges on their correct bases. Keep source drawing revision, assumptions, unit and rounding visible; lock critical formulas and validate inputs.

BIM or specialist estimating software may extract model quantities, but model geometry, classification and exclusions must be checked against drawings and measurement rules. Export the BOQ, compare a manual sample, reconcile revisions and inspect exceptional or negative quantities. A wrong model or incorrect unit can produce a precise-looking but incorrect estimate.
body.gu:
Spreadsheet માં item code, description, number, length, breadth, depth, quantity, unit, rate અને amount રાખી શકાય છે. સરળ volume line માટે quantity = number × length × breadth × depth લો; area, length અને number માટે યોગ્ય અલગ formulas વાપરો. Items પ્રમાણે group કરી dated SOR table સાથે rates જોડો, totals ગણો અને tax/charges યોગ્ય base પર બતાવો. Source drawing revision, assumptions, unit અને rounding દેખાય તેવું રાખો; critical formulas lock અને inputs validate કરો.

BIM અથવા specialist estimating software model માંથી quantities લઈ શકે છે, પરંતુ geometry, classification અને exclusions ને drawings તથા measurement rules સાથે ચકાસવું જરૂરી છે. BOQ export કરો, manual sample થી સરખાવો, revisions reconcile કરો અને exceptional અથવા negative quantities તપાસો. ખોટું model અથવા unit ચોક્કસ દેખાતો પરંતુ ખોટો estimate આપી શકે છે.

body.en:
Given: Over 30 m, end areas are 8 m² and 18 m²; measured midpoint area is 12 m². Find mean end area, mid-sectional and prismoidal volumes.

Step 1. Apply mean end area.

Vtrapezoidal = L(A₁ + A₂) / 2Vtrapezoidal = 30 × (8 + 18) / 2Vtrapezoidal = 390 m³

Step 2. Apply midpoint area.

Vmid = LAmVmid = 30 × 12Vmid = 360 m³

Step 3. Apply prismoidal rule.

Vprismoidal = L(A₁ + 4Am + A₂) / 6Vprismoidal = 30 × (8 + 4 × 12 + 18) / 6Vprismoidal = 370 m³

Final answer:

Mean-end = 390 m³; midpoint = 360 m³; prismoidal = 370 m³.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 30 m length પર end areas 8 m² અને 18 m² છે; માપેલ midpoint area 12 m² છે. Mean end area, mid-sectional અને prismoidal volumes શોધો.

Step 1. Mean end area વાપરો.

Vtrapezoidal = L(A₁ + A₂) / 2Vtrapezoidal = 30 × (8 + 18) / 2Vtrapezoidal = 390 m³

Step 2. Midpoint area વાપરો.

Vmid = LAmVmid = 30 × 12Vmid = 360 m³

Step 3. Prismoidal rule વાપરો.

Vprismoidal = L(A₁ + 4Am + A₂) / 6Vprismoidal = 30 × (8 + 4 × 12 + 18) / 6Vprismoidal = 370 m³

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Mean-end = 390 m³; midpoint = 360 m³; prismoidal = 370 m³.

title.gu: Numerical 4.2 — Septic tank wall volume ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A rectangular tank has clear internal dimensions 3.00 m × 1.50 m and uniform 0.23 m wall thickness. Wall height is 1.50 m. Find external-wall masonry volume, ignoring openings, RCC and partition.

Step 1. Find external dimensions.

Louter = 3.00 + 2 × 0.23Louter = 3.46 mBouter = 1.50 + 2 × 0.23Bouter = 1.96 m

Step 2. Subtract internal from external plan area.

Wall area in plan = (3.46 × 1.96) − (3.00 × 1.50)Wall area in plan = 2.2816 m²

Step 3. Multiply by wall height.

Wall volume = 2.2816 × 1.50Wall volume = 3.4224 m³

Final answer:

External wall masonry ≈ 3.42 m³.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Rectangular tank ના clear internal dimensions 3.00 m × 1.50 m અને uniform wall thickness 0.23 m છે. Wall height 1.50 m છે. Openings, RCC અને partition અવગણી external-wall masonry volume શોધો.

Step 1. External dimensions શોધો.

Louter = 3.00 + 2 × 0.23Louter = 3.46 mBouter = 1.50 + 2 × 0.23Bouter = 1.96 m

Step 2. External plan area માંથી internal area બાદ કરો.

Wall area in plan = (3.46 × 1.96) − (3.00 × 1.50)Wall area in plan = 2.2816 m²

Step 3. Wall height થી ગુણો.

Wall volume = 2.2816 × 1.50Wall volume = 3.4224 m³

અંતિમ જવાબ:

External wall masonry ≈ 3.42 m³.

title.gu: Numerical 4.3 — Circular well lining ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A cylindrical well lining is 5.0 m high with outer diameter 2.4 m and inner diameter 2.0 m. Find annular lining volume.

Step 1. Write annular volume.

V = (π/4)(Douter² − Dinner²)H

Step 2. Substitute dimensions.

V = (π/4)(2.4² − 2.0²) × 5.0

Final answer:

Lining volume ≈ 6.91 m³.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Cylindrical well lining ની height 5.0 m, outer diameter 2.4 m અને inner diameter 2.0 m છે. Annular lining volume ગણો.

Step 1. Annular volume નું સૂત્ર લખો.

V = (π/4)(Douter² − Dinner²)H

Step 2. Dimensions ની કિંમત મૂકો.

V = (π/4)(2.4² − 2.0²) × 5.0

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Lining volume ≈ 6.91 m³.

q.en: What is chainage?
q.gu: Chainage શું છે?

a.en: Distance measured along the project alignment.

q.en: What is a cross-sectional area?
q.gu: Cross-sectional area શું છે?

a.en: Area of the cut or fill at a section.
a.gu: એક section પર cut અથવા fill નો area.

q.en: State the mean end area formula.
q.gu: Mean end area સૂત્ર લખો.

q.en: What is needed for the prismoidal formula?
q.gu: Prismoidal formula માટે શું જરૂરી?

a.en: Both end areas and actual midpoint area.
a.gu: બંને end areas અને actual midpoint area.

q.en: Why separate cut and fill?
q.gu: Cut અને fill અલગ કેમ ગણવા?

a.en: They are different operations and may not balance directly.
a.gu: તે અલગ operations છે અને સીધા balance ન પણ થાય.

q.en: What does m:1 represent?
q.gu: m:1 શું દર્શાવે છે?

a.gu: Horizontal અને vertical નો side slope.

q.en: What does a septic tank do?
q.gu: Septic tank શું કરે છે?

a.en: Settles sewage and provides anaerobic treatment.
a.gu: Sewage settle કરે છે અને anaerobic treatment આપે છે.

q.en: Is septic effluent automatically safe to discharge?
q.gu: Septic effluent આપોઆપ discharge માટે સલામત છે?

a.en: No; approved treatment and disposal are required.
a.gu: નહીં; મંજૂર treatment અને disposal જરૂરી છે.

q.en: How is circular lining measured?
q.gu: Circular lining કેવી રીતે માપાય?

a.en: Using annular cross-sectional area times height.
a.gu: Annular cross-sectional area ને height થી ગુણો.

q.en: Why record excavation diameter separately?
q.gu: Excavation diameter અલગ કેમ નોંધવો?

a.en: It can differ from the lining diameter.
a.gu: તે lining diameter થી જુદો હોઈ શકે.

q.en: Can software replace checking drawings?
q.gu: Software drawings તપાસવાનું બદલી શકે?

a.en: No; input and measurement rules need checking.
a.gu: નહીં; inputs અને measurement rules ચકાસવા પડે.

q.en: What should a spreadsheet retain?
q.gu: Spreadsheet માં શું જાળવવું?

a.en: Units, formulas, source revision and rate basis.
a.gu: Units, formulas, source revision અને rate basis.

q.en: Derive and compare trapezoidal and prismoidal earthwork calculations for given sections.
q.gu: આપેલ sections માટે trapezoidal અને prismoidal earthwork calculations તારવી સરખાવો.

q.en: Calculate a trapezoidal canal cross-section area for given b, d and side slope.

q.en: Differentiate mean end area and mid-sectional methods.
q.gu: Mean end area અને mid-sectional methods નો તફાવત આપો.

q.en: Calculate circular well lining volume from given diameters and height.
